tool_args.rationale: The supplied signatures and verified notes make a temporal two-layer siphon plausible, but its contribution cannot be separated from a present-only response using the current one-dimensional sweep. The targeted open-branch probe is the lowest-cost discriminating acquisition.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a fitted stationary model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five points vary only u_now; u_past, x_now, mem_conv, s_grad, and H are fixed, leaving temporal bridge effects versus present-snapshot response underidentified.
More samples along the same fixed-context trajectory are less informative than varying the open branch/context.
Irrelevant to distinguishing the observed bridge/bullwhip and flux-conservation mechanisms.
